comment: Local mutation testing — proves the high-coverage generator files are backed by KILLING assertions, not just executed lines. Run via scripts/housekeeping.ps1 -Mutation (needs: dotnet tool install -g dotnet-stryker). Scoped to the highest-value files to keep wall-clock sane. NOTE: 'comment' lives OUTSIDE the 'stryker-config' object because Stryker 4.16 REJECTS unknown keys inside it and refuses to run at all ('the allowed keys for the "stryker-config" object are {...} but "comment" was found'). It sat inside until 2026-08-16, so this leg could not have run. A SECOND defect was found the same day: 'mutate' globs resolve against the PROJECT directory (src/DwarfMapper.Generator), not the repo root, so the old repo-root-relative paths matched nothing — Stryker then reports 'Removed by mutate filter' for every mutant and STILL EXITS 0, which housekeeping's $LASTEXITCODE check cannot detect. Both are fixed here, but this leg has still never produced a score: the thresholds below are INHERITED AND UNVALIDATED, and the first successful run must re-measure 'break' the way stryker-config.runtime.json does.
